components.name: Primary Button
components.description: Filled pill for the main action; ink fill with inverse text.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { height: 3rem; padding: 0 1.25rem; border: 0; border-radius: 9999px; background: #141a2e; color: #fff; font: 600 0.9375rem 'Plus Jakarta Sans', system-ui, sans-serif; cursor: pointer; transition: transform 150ms cubic-bezier(0.22,1,0.36,1), background-color 220ms; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: #000; } .ds-btn-primary:active { transform: scale(0.97); } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #141a2e; outline-offset: 3px; }

components.name: Secondary Button
components.css: .ds-btn-secondary { height: 3rem; padding: 0 1.25rem; border: 1px solid #ffffffcc; border-radius: 9999px; background: transparent; color: #141a2e; font: 600 0.9375rem 'Plus Jakarta Sans', system-ui, sans-serif; cursor: pointer; transition: transform 150ms cubic-bezier(0.22,1,0.36,1), background-color 220ms; } .ds-btn-secondary:hover { background: #ffffffd9; } .ds-btn-secondary:active { transform: scale(0.97); } .ds-btn-secondary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #141a2e; outline-offset: 3px; }

components.name: Filter Chip
components.description: Pill filter with a count; selected inverts to the primary fill.
components.css: .ds-chip { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 6px; min-height: 2.75rem; padding: 0 0.875rem; margin-right: 6px; border: 1px solid #ffffffcc; border-radius: 9999px; background: transparent; color: #454956; font: 600 0.9375rem 'Plus Jakarta Sans', system-ui, sans-serif; cursor: pointer; transition: background-color 220ms; } .ds-chip span { font-size: 0.75rem; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; color: #4a4e5c; } .ds-chip:hover { background: #ffffffd9; color: #141a2e; } .ds-chip-on { background: #141a2e; border-color: transparent; color: #fff; } .ds-chip-on span { color: #fff; opacity: 0.7; } .ds-chip:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #141a2e; outline-offset: 3px; }

components.name: Glass Card
components.description: A frosted pane: translucent fill, hairline edge, soft shadow.
components.css: .ds-card { padding: 1rem; border: 1px solid #ffffff99; border-radius: 1.5rem; background: #ffffff73; backdrop-filter: blur(14px); box-shadow: inset 0 1px 0 #fff, 0 12px 32px -20px #1d224059; color: #141a2e; font-family: 'Plus Jakarta Sans', system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-card h3 { margin: 0; font-size: 1.125rem; font-weight: 600; letter-spacing: -0.025em; } .ds-card p { margin: 4px 0 0; font-size: 0.9375rem; color: #454956; }

components.name: Lit Tile
components.description: Signature device tile: quiet pane when off, amber glow when on.
components.css: .ds-tile { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 2px; padding: 1rem; border-radius: 1.5rem; background: #ffffff73; color: #141a2e; box-shadow: inset 0 1px 0 #fff, 0 12px 32px -20px #1d224059; font-family: 'Plus Jakarta Sans', system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-tile strong { font-weight: 600; } .ds-tile span { font-size: 0.8125rem; color: #454956; } .ds-tile-on { background: linear-gradient(135deg, #ffffff, #f8e6c4); box-shadow: inset 0 1px 0 #fff, 0 0 0 1px #fff, 0 18px 48px -10px #ffc770b3; } .ds-tile-on span { color: #8a5a10; }

narrative.overview: Casa is a window onto the house. Panes of frosted glass float over a soft, slowly drifting field of light, and the home's controls sit on those panes. Anything that is on, playing or open carries the warm amber of a lit window; everything else stays cool, quiet and translucent. The screen is read at arm's length and across a room, so state is communicated by type size, one warm color and contrast, not by dense decoration.
keyCharacteristics: Frosted translucent panes (blur 14px) over a fixed, living background; never opaque slabs.
One warm accent, the amber "light", marks active state; the ink color is the interactive fill.
Pills for actions and selection, large rounded rectangles for containers.
Large touch targets (44px minimum) and room-readable type.
One motion language of short springs and exponential ease-out; a reduced-motion preference silences it.

rules.name: The One Warm Voice Rule
rules.body: Amber means "on". It is never used for decoration, hover, or branding. If everything glows, nothing is on.

rules.name: The Alpha Surface Rule
rules.body: Surfaces are translucent colors over a background layer, never opaque fills. Read contrast against the worst point of the background, not the average.

rules.name: The Arm's Length Rule
rules.body: Anything a person acts on (names, times, state) is at least body size. Nothing is set below 0.8125rem (the Label size); dense secondary text uses Label, never a smaller literal size.

rules.name: The Light-Not-Weight Rule
rules.body: Never stack hard or zero-blur shadows. Elevation is an inner highlight plus a soft downward spread, and an active glow is the only colored shadow.

dos: Do let translucency do the work: panes over the background layer with a 14px blur.
Do use Window Amber only to indicate that something is on, playing or active.
Do keep every touch target at least 2.75rem, and primary actions pill-shaped.
Do use tabular numerals for times, counts and scores.
Do treat light and dark as peers: check contrast against the worst point of the background in both.
Do take timing, easing and springs from src/lib/motion.ts and the CSS motion tokens.
Do give reduced motion a quieter equivalent: a busy spinner becomes a slow fade, not a frozen icon.
Do keep the visible control and the hit area separate when an icon button must look small: the target stays 2.75rem.
donts: Don't extend or reference Walnut or Modern in new work; they are legacy themes.
Don't put amber on decoration, hover states or branding.
Don't use opaque slabs, hard offset shadows, or zero-blur block shadows.
Don't hide state in color alone; pair it with a label, icon or text.
Don't let a horizontal scroller widen the page; contain it in a bounded row.
Don't nest cards inside cards; separate groups with spacing and headings instead.
Don't set text below 0.8125rem, or use a bounce or overshoot curve.
